# University of Derby

> University of Derby offers undergraduate and further education programs across computing, engineering, business, creative writing, healthcare, and social sciences with strong industry partnerships and placement opportunities.

The University of Derby provides comprehensive course information, student success stories, and access to library research tools through LibGuides. The institution emphasizes employability, professional accreditations (CMI, RICS, CIOB, BACP, Royal Society of Biology), and real-world experience through placement years and industry partnerships.

## Course Search and Study Hub

- [Study](https://www.derby.ac.uk/study): University of Derby course search and study options hub
- [LibGuides at University of Derby](https://libguides.derby.ac.uk/home): LibGuides homepage for University of Derby library services and research tools

## Business and Management Programs

- [Business Management BA (Hons) with Placement Year](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/business-management-courses/business-management-ba-hons-with-placement-year): BA (Hons) Business Management with CMI accreditation and placement year
- [Business Management and Sustainable Practice BA (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/business-management-courses/business-management-sustainable-practice-ba-hons): BA (Hons) Business Management and Sustainable Practice with CMI accreditation
- [Media and Marketing BA (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/joint-honours-courses/media-and-marketing-ba-hons): BA (Hons) Media and Marketing joint honours undergraduate degree

## Engineering and Construction Programs

- [Computer Science BSc (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/computing-courses/computer-science-bsc-hons): BSc (Hons) Computer Science with placement year and industry partnerships
- [Construction Management BSc (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/civil-engineering-construction-courses/construction-management-bsc-hons): BSc (Hons) Construction Management with RICS and CIOB accreditation

## Health Sciences and Life Sciences Programs

- [Human Biology BSc (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/biomedical-science-courses/human-biology-bsc-hons): BSc (Hons) Human Biology with Royal Society of Biology accreditation
- [Counselling and Psychotherapy BSc (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/counselling-psychotherapy-courses/counselling-psychotherapy-bsc-hons/careers): BSc (Hons) Counselling and Psychotherapy with BACP accreditation

## Arts, Humanities and Education Programs

- [English, Creative Writing and Publishing Undergraduate Courses](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/english-creative-writing-publishing-courses): English, Creative Writing and Publishing undergraduate course options
- [Creative Writing and Publishing BA (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/english-creative-writing-publishing-courses/creative-writing-publishing-ba-hons): BA (Hons) Creative Writing and Publishing undergraduate degree program
- [English and Education Studies BA (Hons)](https://www.derby.ac.uk/undergraduate/joint-honours-courses/english-and-education-studies-ba-hons): BA (Hons) English and Education Studies joint honours degree
- [Education and Early Years](https://www.derby.ac.uk/further-education/courses/education-and-early-years): Early Years T Level and practitioner courses for further education
